Styleguide.title: The design system
Styleguide.intro: Every value this product is allowed to use, shown doing its real job on the real paper. If a screen needs something that is not here, the system is wrong, not the screen.

color.green-soft: Text at 20px and up, icons, graphics
color.human: The motif and the result reveal, nothing else

pairs.body: Body text sits here, at full ink.
pairs.secondary: Secondary text carries the quieter half of a screen.
pairs.greenSoft: Green at twenty pixels and up
pairs.note: Judged on the surface it actually lands on, never on white.

type.sample: Paste the posting, keep your voice

motion.easing: One easing family: a soft spring with high damping. Nothing bounces, nothing spins, nothing scales up from zero. Reduced motion swaps all of it for instant states.

button.note: One green action per screen. Everything else is an outline or plain text.
